# Texture sources

`wood_table_001_diff_512.png` is a 512 px derivative of Poly Haven's
[Wood Table 001](https://polyhaven.com/a/wood_table_001) diffuse texture by
Dimitrios Savva and Rico Cilliers. The source asset is released under CC0.

`terlenka_diff_1k.png` is the 1K diffuse map from Poly Haven's
[Terlenka](https://polyhaven.com/a/terlenka) fabric material by colormass and
Rico Cilliers. The source asset is released under CC0. The checked-in file has
MD5 `17347e440cd178a40b369e7572a6ec50`.

Sources for the task-object textures are documented with their matching meshes
in [`../meshes/SOURCES.md`](../meshes/SOURCES.md).
